*Kusalattika, Vitakkattika* (Patthana 23.5) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka. Structurally, the text examines the conditional relations arising from the combination of the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*) and the triad pertaining to applied thought (*vitakkattika*).

No cross-language parallels in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan are identified for this text [DharmaNexus]. Automated text analysis by DharmaNexus nevertheless reveals significant Pali-internal text reuse, showing 110 matching passages across 36 other Pali texts, situated primarily within parallel combinatorial sections of the *Paṭṭhāna* [DharmaNexus]. The most extensive passage sharing occurs with *Kusalattika, Āsavagocchaka* (Patthana 22.6; 10 matches, with segment §1.1–2.1 sharing text with §8.1–9.1), *Kusalattika, Piṭṭhiduka* (Patthana 16.25; 8 matches, sharing §1.1–3.1 with §9.1–12.1), *Kusalattika, Parittārammaṇattika* (Patthana 17.12), *Kusalattika, Hetusahetukadukādi* (Patthana 22.4), and *Kusalattika, Pītittika* (Patthana 23.6) [DharmaNexus]. It also shares passages directly with other formulations involving the *vitakka* triad, including another section titled *Kusalattika, Vitakkattika* (Patthana 17.5) and the inverted pairing *Vitakkattika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 23.24) [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
